name: EDCCN
description: A benchmark encoder-decoder framework intended to standardize evaluation and improve accuracy for crowd counting models across datasets.
evaluation_method: MAE/MSE (mean absolute error / mean squared error)
reputation: New encoder–decoder benchmarking framework for crowd counting; emerging adoption in crowd-counting research communities.
notes: Non-LLM, vision-focused benchmark; results depend on dataset variations and annotation protocols. Potential issues include dataset heterogeneity across scenes, biases in crowd distributions, and sensitivity to evaluation split choices.
